summary.headline: Moon in Planetary Houses
summary.text: Astrological judgments from the Moon’s placement in the houses of Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Sun, Venus, and Mercury, including effects on temperament, inheritance, status, litigation, royal benefits, music, and intelligence. A cautionary rule ranks one, two, or three testimonies by strength and notes weakness in cadent houses and movable signs.
